train_df['region_r3'] = (train_df['region'] == 'r3').astype(int)

test_df['region_r3'] = (test_df['region'] == 'r3').astype(int)

train_df['hour_cos'] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * train_df['hour'] / 24)

test_df['hour_cos'] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * test_df['hour'] / 24)
